mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at clear skies and 52 degrees outside of Verona City Hall.

City officials have announced that pavement repairs will take place this Tuesday and Wednesday. Work includes milling and patching on Morningside Boulevard, Mozart Street, and several other locations, so please plan your travels accordingly.
Looking at the local calendar, we have live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard today, and tomorrow you can head to Insight Wellness for a yoga session.
In our police report for October 19, officers conducted a traffic stop that resulted in an arrest after it was discovered the individual had an active arrest warrant.
Stop by Culver's of Verona today to enjoy the delicious Snickers Swirl flavor of the day, as the restaurant is currently open and will be serving guests until 10:00 PM.
